summary: Registers a media type for Downloadable Sounds, a MIDI-related format for instrument sound data. It is informational.

eli5.summary: This gives a file type for musical instrument sound samples an official name.

subtitle: Official media type designation for downloadable sound instruments used in MIDI synthesis.

tldr.problem: Downloadable Sounds (DLS) files are used to define instruments for wavetable synthesizers in MIDI systems, but had no official media type designation, making it difficult to serve them correctly over HTTP or include them in multi-part documents.
tldr.mechanism: This RFC registers the media type audio/dls with the Internet Assigned Numbers Authority (IANA), establishing a standard identifier and metadata format for DLS files including an optional parameter to specify the DLS version level.
tldr.outcome: The audio/dls media type is now officially registered and can be used to correctly identify and handle DLS files in applications and on the web.

today: The audio/dls media type is now registered with IANA and in use for identifying DLS format files. MIDI synthesizers, music production software, and multimedia applications use this media type when serving or processing downloadable sound instrument definitions.

sections.title: What Downloadable Sounds Are
sections.content:
Downloadable Sounds (DLS) is a file format used to define instruments for wavetable synthesizers associated with MIDI (Musical Instrument Digital Interface) standards. DLS files are maintained and defined by two organizations: the MIDI Manufacturers Association (MMA) and the Association of the Musical Electronics Industry (AMEI).

DLS format comes in three levels: DLS Level 1.1b, DLS Level 2.1, and Mobile Downloadable Sounds. These standards allow programs to package instrument definitions in a portable format. Before this media type registration, there was no standardized way to identify DLS files when they were served over HTTP, included in multi-part email messages, or used in other contexts where media types matter.
sections.eli5: DLS files are like recipe cards for music. They tell the computer how to make different instrument sounds. Now there's an official name for them, just like "photo" or "song".

sections.title: Media Type Registration
sections.content:
The registered media type is audio/dls. It has one optional parameter: dls-type, which specifies the DLS version levels the file conforms to. The parameter accepts comma-separated values: 0 for DLS Level 1.1b, 1 for DLS Level 2.1, and 2 for Mobile Downloadable Sounds. Multiple values can be listed if the file conforms to multiple levels. If the parameter is not specified, it defaults to level 0 (DLS Level 1.1b).

DLS files are binary files and must be transmitted without CR/LF conversion or 7-bit stripping; Base64 encoding is recommended. The registered file extension is .dls.
sections.eli5: The official name is audio/dls. You can add a note saying which version of the format it uses, but if you don't, it assumes the basic version.

sections.title: Security Issues with DLS Files
sections.content:
DLS files can contain audio data, displayable text, and modeling parameters (articulation parameters). Additionally, DLS format includes a conditional chunk that is active, meaning it affects how a DLS file parser executes. However, the DLS format does not currently support scripting mechanisms.

Conditional chunks in DLS are optional, so a parser need not execute them. If a parser does evaluate a conditional chunk, it can still parse its content and determine whether it is usable for a particular synthesizer engine. Malicious DLS files could theoretically contain large amounts of conditional data, but synthesizers typically protect themselves by parsing conditionally and safely.

DLS files support optional metadata fields that may protect content against unauthorized use under WIPO treaties. The format is extensible, making it theoretically possible to add new metadata in the future, but such capabilities are not currently supported.
sections.eli5: DLS files could be tricky if someone tried to hide bad stuff in them, but music programs are designed to be safe. The files don't have scripts that run, so the worst they can do is waste space or ask for permission before loading bad data.

sections.title: How DLS Files Are Used
sections.content:
The audio/dls media type is intended for consumption by a MIDI player capable of utilizing downloadable sounds for synthesizers. A general-purpose audio player will not be able to play the audio within a DLS file without explicit support for the format. DLS files are consumed by specialized MIDI applications, synthesizer control software, and multi-media systems that include MIDI playback capabilities.

The specifications for DLS levels are available from the MIDI Manufacturers Association (www.midi.org). The format has been used in commercial music production systems, mobile devices, and consumer electronics that include MIDI synthesis capabilities.
sections.eli5: Only music programs that understand DLS can use these files. Your regular music player can't play them directly, but a MIDI synthesizer or music production program can use the instrument definitions they contain.
